perspective:
Brandon’s accessible information:

- He knows his own identity/role: Brandon Talayumptewa, insurance agent; Alaska Native; bachelor’s degree; ISTP profile.
- He meets Benjamin Erickson, a business client/entrepreneur seeking business insurance advice. He is aware/believes Benjamin has limited formal education, so he initially worries about explaining complex insurance details effectively.
- First meeting: Benjamin wants comprehensive business coverage and says some terms are new to him. Brandon explains liability and asset protection using safety-net/guard analogies and a slip-and-fall example. He hears Benjamin ask for an example, ask about assets, say it simplifies things, and thank him.
- Second meeting: Brandon has revised his belief about Benjamin’s ability to understand detailed information; he feels more confident and plans to discuss more complex details. He hears Benjamin say he is ready and has been reading up. Brandon explains business interruption and property insurance; he hears Benjamin call business interruption crucial and property coverage reassuring.
- Lunch meeting: Brandon feels insecure about Benjamin possibly seeing him as overly cautious/detail-focused and wants to keep discussions interesting. He hears Benjamin appreciate his thoroughness while also enjoying lighter moments. Brandon tells the taste-buds insurance anecdote; he hears Benjamin find it fascinating and sensible given the stakes. Brandon compares risk assessment to Benjamin’s business; Benjamin says it is less unusual but equally important.
- Later meeting: Brandon feels pleased by Benjamin’s positive response to his anecdotes and decides to add value beyond insurance. He asks about strategic investments that could lower premiums and suggests security upgrades can protect assets and reduce costs. He hears Benjamin say he had not considered it, it sounds smart/win-win, and he wants to explore it further.
- Joint venture: Encouraged by rapport and mutual benefits, Brandon feels optimistic and proposes co-developing a platform integrating risk management with financial planning for entrepreneurs. He hears Benjamin agree, call it groundbreaking, say combining their expertise could set them apart, and agree to draft initial plans.
